'''Jalaam Lazari''' was one a powerful noble in the [[Free Years]].

==History==
In c. {{fy|1096}}, forces led by Lord Jalaam Lazari, Lord [[Ahran Nawaz]], and Lady [[Bastine Almadar]] took the city of [[Bandar Eban]] and declared a nation that would become Arad Doman, and would ally themselves to an informal council of merchants, which would become formalized during the end of the [[War of the Hundred Years]].

Lord Jalaam's second son, [[Shelaan Lazari]], would become the first King of Arad Doman in c. {{fy|1116}}.
